text: Rewrote the AC16 test to discover the cache's location rather than name it. The first version asserted that no staged path contained '.pawl/.cache', which survived the obvious mutation — moving the cache to .pawl/surfaced puts it outside the ignore rule, exactly what AC16 forbids, and the test passed. It now snapshots .pawl before and after MarkSurfaced and asserts that whatever was written is unstaged.
